# v0.8.0

Investigate a failed feed and see which detections read it.

- `deadair inspect` opens a saved report by source or expected producer. It shows the evidence,
  dependent detections ordered by severity, and a first check. Use `--instance` for fleet reports
  and `--links` for available native SIEM and runbook links.
- Sentinel policies can define expected firewall feeds by vendor, product, or device. One quiet
  producer can now be detected inside a busy shared table. Confirmed producer dependencies are
  listed separately from other detections that read the table.
- Scheduled and NRT rules sharing a Sentinel table now retain separate event-time and
  ingestion-time freshness evidence.
- Quiet producers and failed or overdue summary pipelines have stable findings, report diffs,
  optional gates, and Prometheus metrics. Maintenance suppresses alerts without removing the
  observation. Recovery requires new successful evidence.
- Terminal and HTML reports put findings first. Source details are available without another
  scan, and the guides include the investigation workflow and two short, pausable lab recordings.

This release also includes the freshness, candidate-assessment, proxy, and certificate-handling
fixes merged since v0.7.0. JSON report changes are additive; the report format remains
`deadair.report.v1`.

Expected-producer monitoring is opt-in and currently supports Sentinel. Existing policies keep
their gate classes. See the [investigation guide](https://github.com/alephnull-sh/deadair/blob/v0.8.0/docs/investigate.md)
for configuration and the [validation record](https://github.com/alephnull-sh/deadair/blob/v0.8.0/docs/validation.md)
for live coverage and tested limits.
